subject.title: [Feature]: Expose sessionKey/runId to outbound message hook for deterministic verification

question: Should outbound message hooks expose bounded per-run tool/transcript evidence, or should deterministic verification use a narrower safer plugin seam?
rationale: The remaining request changes the public plugin API and exposes sensitive session/tool data before delivery, so automation should not choose the permanent security boundary.

options.title: Define bounded evidence contract
options.body: Add runId and a redacted, size-limited recent evidence view to the pre-send hook with explicit docs, permissions, and tests across shared and direct reply paths.

options.title: Limit to runId only
options.body: Thread outbound runId now but leave tool/transcript evidence for a separate security design, which improves correlation but does not satisfy deterministic verification.

options.title: Route to another seam
options.body: Keep message_sending text-only and require verification plugins to use reply_payload_sending, diagnostics, or a future dedicated verification hook.

recommendation.title: Define bounded evidence contract
recommendation.body: Add runId and a redacted, size-limited recent evidence view to the pre-send hook with explicit docs, permissions, and tests across shared and direct reply paths.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete already reviewed this issue's remaining gap and has recent outbound-delivery history, making him the best available routing owner for the security/product call.
